overview: The City Council organized leadership for 2025 by re-electing its president and vice president, and enacted the Welcoming City Ordinance codifying policies on federal immigration enforcement. The Council also approved school facility loan orders, Community Preservation Act park funding, an ordinance for veteran rental housing incentives, and debated Building Department emergency response policies.

items.title: Election of 2025 Council Leadership
items.summary: Elected Councilor Zac Bears as Council President and Councilor Kit Collins as Council Vice President for 2025.

items.title: Annual Rules, Records, and Condolences
items.summary: Adopted the standing committee rules, transferred pending matters from the 2024 council, approved meeting records, and recognized condolences for John Granara and Ralph Evangelista.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved reports from the Committee of the Whole on leadership and the governing agenda, and from the Governance Committee regarding the city charter review roadmap.

items.title: Open Data Policy Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution to establish an open data system for city information to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Support and Programming for Youth with Disabilities
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution urging the administration to expand recreation programming for youth with disabilities and requesting additional staffing in the fiscal year 2026 budget.

items.title: School HVAC and Roof Infrastructure Loan Order
items.summary: Approved for third reading a loan order funding HVAC improvements and roof repairs at the McGlynn School complex and the Andrews Middle School.

items.title: Community Control Over Public Surveillance Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Approved on third reading amendments to the surveillance ordinance governing the disposal of improperly collected data and restricting the commercial transfer of surveillance data.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance
items.summary: Approved on third reading and ordained the Welcoming City Ordinance as amended to remove an exception clause regarding police department enforcement.

items.title: Carr Park Phase Two CPA Appropriation
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $146,000 from Community Preservation Act reserve funds for phase two renovations at Carr Park.

items.title: Veteran Housing Rental Incentives Ordinance
items.summary: Waived all readings and ordained an ordinance amendment authorizing the Director of Veteran Services to partner with non-profits to provide cash incentives to landlords renting to qualified veterans.

items.title: Building Department Overtime and Emergency Response Policies
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting an administrative report and interdepartmental collaboration regarding after-hours building inspection protocols, while rejecting a motion to demand immediate reinstatement of past emergency response practices.

items.title: Meadow Glen Sign Special Permit Amendment
items.summary: Closed the public hearing and approved an amendment to a special permit for freestanding signs at 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: Common Victualler License and Tabled Business
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for The Establishment at 175 Rivers Edge Drive and voted to table two subsequent agenda papers to the next meeting.

items.title: Public Participation on Meeting Length
items.summary: Discussed meeting procedures and late adjournment times during open public participation.
